## Claims
- [source-backed] In \(\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), Schur multiplication is truncated Littlewood–Richardson multiplication. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 263-269]
- [proved] Put \(J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\), \(L_\rho=\bar s_{(333,\rho)}\), and \(R_{\rho'}=\bar s_{(3+\rho'_1,3+\rho'_2,3+\rho'_3)}\). The following nine exact Pieri identities lie in \(A_+J\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
R_\varnothing-L_\varnothing&=0,\\
R_{1}+L_{1}&=h_1L_\varnothing,\\
R_{2}-L_{2}&=h_1R_1-h_2L_\varnothing,\\
R_{11}-L_{11}&=h_2L_\varnothing-h_1L_1,\\
R_{3}+L_{3}&=h_1R_2-h_2R_1+h_3L_\varnothing,\\
R_{21}+L_{21}&=h_1R_{11}+h_1L_2-h_3L_\varnothing,\\
R_{31}-L_{31}
&=h_1R_3+h_1R_{11}-h_1R_{21}+h_1L_3+h_1L_{21}
+h_1L_3-2h_3L_1,\\
R_{22}-L_{22}
&=h_1R_{21}-h_1R_3-2h_1R_{11}+h_1R_{21}
-h_1L_3-h_1L_{21}\\
&\quad-2h_1L_3-h_2L_2-h_2L_{11}+4h_3L_1,\\
R_{32}+L_{32}
&=h_1R_{22}-h_3R_{11}+h_4R_1-h_1R_3+h_5L_\varnothing+h_1L_{31}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here repeated terms are intentional as written; every displayed Schur factor is in \(J\), and every \(h_t\) has \(1\le t\le5\).
- [unsupported] No exact identity for the remaining boundary partition \(\rho=(3,3)\),
\[
R_{33}-L_{33}=\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333},
\]
is supplied by the available material.

## Strategy
The nine identities follow by expanding each \(h_t\bar s_\lambda\) by the horizontal-strip Pieri rule and collecting terms. They give the requested signs through degrees \(9,\dots,14\):
\[
[1],\ [-1],\ I_2,\ -I_2,\ I_2,\ [-1].
\]
The degree-\(15\) entry \([1]\) requires the missing identity for \((3,3)\).

## Gaps
The \(\rho=(3,3)\) witness is absent. Therefore the full transition
\[
\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,I_2,-I_2,I_2,-1,1)
\]
and the requested certificate are **not established**.

## Next

\(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\in A_+J\).
